name: usb_c_sink
summary: USB Type-C receptacle (USB 2.0) as a power sink at default USB power: 5.1 kohm Rd on CC1 and CC2, D+/D- out, bulk capacitor at the power entrance.

sources.document: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.0, table 4-25 Sink CC Termination (Rd) Requirements

USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.0, section 4.8.1.2 (USB-based chargers with captive cables): 4.75 V - 5.5 V with no load and 4.0 V - 5.5 V at 3 A at the plug (figure 4-38). Section 4.4.2 (page 141) says the default VBUS range of other sources is set by the USB 2.0 / 3.2 specifications, which were not retrieved; this wider range is used as a conservative bound
USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.0: Default USB Type-C Current is the USB specification's high-power value, 500 mA for USB 2.0 ports
GCT drawing USB4105 (pin table: SHELL = GND)
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.2 Power Supply

ports.name: vbus
ports.note: the lowest bound of figure 4-38 (4.0 V at 3 A) is used, so the range is conservative for lighter loads

notes.text: A sink uses Rd = 5.1 kohm +/-10 % to GND on each CC pin; the 1 % resistors meet it. This advertises a sink only: no USB PD, so the source gives default USB power.
The shield is connected to GND, as the GCT drawing's pin table lists SHELL = GND.
SBU1 and SBU2 are not used by USB 2.0 and are left unconnected.
At least 10 uF at the main power entrance (Espressif); an ESD protection diode is also suggested and is NOT included (no ESD part in the library yet).
